title: Listening Drill — Documentary film club — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Documentary film club — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on documentary film club last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with late arrival. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: cancelled screening.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of seat number so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow booking receipt instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the club secretary before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Tuesday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
